description: Re-run the search-data reconcile for the roadmap now, instead of waiting for the weekly run. It uses the brand's real search queries (last 90 days) to re-rank SUGGESTED roadmap items, hide items an existing page already covers (or that rank top 3), import observed keywords, and add or update `refresh` items for pages that rank poorly. Approved, writing, published and completed items are never re-ranked, and per-item overrides (restore / pin / remove via seo_roadmap_edit) are respected. It never rewrites an article by itself: refresh items only start when you call seo_roadmap_edit action="start". Returns immediately (202); the work runs in the background. Poll seo_search_data_status until reconcile.status is completed (a minute or more; the summary then lists what changed). 400 if no search data has synced yet (connect Search Console or Bing first); 409 if a run is already in progress.
name: seo_search_data_reconcile
